suppress.notes: CPE mismatch: PCS uses only the Java OTel client; these CVEs target the JS/Go clients which are absent from this codebase

HDPI-9102: false positive (CPE mismatch). CVE-2026-33117 affects only com.azure:azure-security-keyvault-keys < 4.10.6, which PCS does not depend on. NVD records it against the whole "azure_sdk_for_java" product, before 4.10.6, so dependency-check flags every com.azure jar whose own version number is below 4.10.6. https://github.com/advisories/ghsa-97jf-46m3-8953 Re-review by the until date.

HDPI-9102: false positive (already patched). CVE-2023-36415 was fixed in azure-identity 1.10.2, and CVE-2024-35255 in azure-identity 1.12.2 / msal4j 1.15.1. PCS has azure-identity 1.18.4 and msal4j 1.23.1. NVD's CPE version ranges for these products do not line up with the Java artifact versions. Re-review by the until date.

HDPI-8691: false positive (CPE mismatch). CVE-2026-133981 is an infinite loop on crafted compressed payloads in the Elasticsearch server node. PCS ships only the Java client (elasticsearch-java / elasticsearch-rest5-client), not the server. NVD's cpe:elastic:elasticsearch ranges match the client jars by product name. https://discuss.elastic.co/t/391847 Re-review by the until date.
